atlas:
Use case: logo-brand. Produce ONE 3 by 3 atlas of flat monochrome interface glyphs for the Neuroshima virtual tabletop RPG, matching image 1 strictly for STYLE AND FORMAT ONLY. Do not copy any reference subject. Exactly equal square cells, no drawn grid lines or labels. Pure solid WHITE shapes on a perfectly clean solid BLACK background. No grey, other colors, shading, gradients, texture, outlines around a white shape, speckles, distress, text, lettering, numbers, music notes or logos. Serious utilitarian object silhouettes, broad black negative-space cuts, restrained detail readable at 16 screen pixels. Each complete glyph centered inside its own cell, at most 75% cell width/height, generous black margin and separation, nothing crossing a cell edge. EXACT row-major order, left to right then top to bottom:
CELL 1: A single accordion with expanded broad bellows, a short piano-key board at the right side, two solid end blocks. Only four broad bellows folds and three black keys; no decorative pattern.
CELL 2: One banjo: unmistakable round soundbox, long narrow neck with a few stout tuning pegs. One broad circular negative-space inset and a simple neck slit; no fine strings.
CELL 3: One acoustic guitar, rounded double-waisted body with a single large black round soundhole and a complete long neck. No cable or pickups; broad simple silhouette.
CELL 4: One electric BASS guitar with an especially long neck, small slim asymmetric double-cutaway body and four broad tuning pegs on one side, plus one short stout cable tail. No acoustic soundhole, no tiny strings.
CELL 5: One electric guitar with a broad double-cutaway solid body, shorter neck than the bass, one broad black rectangular pickup cutout and a short thick curled cable tail. No acoustic soundhole.
CELL 6: One harmonica in a slightly angled side view: a stout compact oblong rectangle with one row of FIVE large square black air holes. No writing, texture or fine grille.
CELL 7: One compact electronic keyboard viewed slightly from above: a wide rectangular slab, a row of seven broad white piano keys separated by large black cuts, and two solid round knobs. No labels or stand.
CELL 8: One electric UPRIGHT DOUBLE BASS: very tall vertical neck, a slim skeletal curved body frame, and one stout endpin at the bottom. Clear upright bass silhouette, no player or stand and no acoustic guitar body.
CELL 9: One audio mixing console WITH ONE small speaker beside it: a squat rectangular mixer with three broad vertical fader slots and stout slider knobs, speaker with one large black circular cone. Two clear main masses; no lettering or tiny control grid.
One clear complete subject per active cell. Maintain the exact layout.
